coalesce(sum(q1points), 0) from (select count(1) * case when greatest(pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, pd.final_design_signed_date::date, pd.financial_agreement_signed_date::date) between join flow.project p on p.id = pd.project_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = pd.closer_user_id where pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and case pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and pd.utility_bill_verified_date is not null and case when pd.primary_financier = 119 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null and sql.closerDashboard.getRoundRobins: SELECT pcz.id, pcz.company_id, pcz.zone_name, pczu.archived FROM flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON up.id = pczu.user_position_id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON p.id = up.position_id INNER JOIN flow.postal_code_zone pcz ON pcz.id = pczu.postal_code_zone_id WHERE up.user_id = :userId AND pczu.archived IS FALSE AND pcz.archived IS FALSE AND p.schedulable IS TRUE
sql.closerDashboard.getCloserTableScores: SELECT u.id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, ust.user_status_type, o.org_name as officeName, o2.org_name as region, coalesce(lov.name, '--') as metroArea, count( case when pd.closer_appointment_start::date >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and pd.source not in (7, 8, 484) and pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and pd.utility_bill_verified_date is not null and (pd.proof_of_homeowners_insurance_obtained_date is not null or pd.proof_of_homeowners_insurance_required = 306) and case when pd.primary_financier = 119 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null and greatest(final_design_signed_date, financial_agreement_signed_date, first_cash_payment_paid_date, utility_bill_verified_date, proof_of_homeowners_insurance_obtained_date) >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval else greatest(final_design_signed_date, financial_agreement_signed_date, proof_of_homeowners_insurance_obtained_date, utility_bill_verified_date) >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval end and ((pd.cancelled_date is null) or (pd.cancelled_date is not null and pd.cancelled_date > now())) and p.company_project_status_type_id != 3 then 1 end ) as leadGenFdcPercentageNumerator, count( case when pd.closer_appointment_start::date >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and pd.source not in (7, 8, 484) then 1 end ) as leadGenFdcPercentageDenominator, count( case when greatest(final_design_signed_date, financial_agreement_signed_date, first_cash_payment_paid_date, utility_bill_verified_date, proof_of_homeowners_insurance_obtained_date) >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and pd.source in (7, 8, 484) and pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and pd.utility_bill_verified_date is not null and (pd.proof_of_homeowners_insurance_obtained_date is not null or pd.proof_of_homeowners_insurance_required = 306) and case when pd.primary_financier = 119 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null else 1=1 end and ((pd.cancelled_date is null) or (pd.cancelled_date is not null and pd.cancelled_date > now())) and p.company_project_status_type_id != 3 then 1 end ) as selfGenFdc, count( case when greatest(final_design_signed_date, financial_agreement_signed_date, first_cash_payment_paid_date) >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and pd.final_design_signed_date is not null and pd.financial_agreement_signed_date is not null and pd.utility_bill_verified_date is not null and (pd.proof_of_homeowners_insurance_obtained_date is not null or pd.proof_of_homeowners_insurance_required = 306) and case when pd.primary_financier = 119 then pd.first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null else 1=1 end and ((pd.cancelled_date is null) or (pd.cancelled_date is not null and pd.cancelled_date > now())) and p.company_project_status_type_id != 3 then 1 end ) as totalFdc FROM brs.project_details pd INNER JOIN flow.project p ON p.id = pd.project_id INNER JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = pd.closer_user_id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.company_user_status cus on cus.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = cus.user_status_type_id INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = up.org_id INNER JOIN flow.org o2 ON (o2.id = o.parent_org_id and o2.org_type_id = 2) LEFT JOIN flow.organization_custom_field_value ocfv ON ocfv.org_id = o.id LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON ocfv.int_value = lov.id WHERE CASE WHEN :officeFdcRank IS TRUE THEN -- Office FDC Rank table up.org_id IN (select distinct org_id from flow.user_position where user_id = :currentUserId and archived is false and primary_flag is true) ELSE -- Company Ranking (2nd row of tables) up.position_id = 1 AND up.archived IS FALSE AND up.end_date IS NULL AND o.active_flag IS TRUE AND o2.active_flag IS TRUE END AND ust.user_status_type = 'Active' GROUP BY u.id, officeName, region, metroArea, ust.user_status_type
sql.closerDashboard.getBrsProvidedSources: SELECT distinct pd.source as source_id, lov.name as source_name FROM brs.project_details pd INNER JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = pd.source WHERE pd.source NOT IN (7, 484, 8) -- ('Closer Gen', 'Events - Closer Gen', 'Referral') ORDER BY source_name
sql.closerDashboard.getSelfGenSources: SELECT distinct pd.source as source_id, lov.name as source_name FROM brs.project_details pd INNER JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = pd.source WHERE pd.source IN (7, 484, 8) -- ('Closer Gen', 'Events - Closer Gen', 'Referral') ORDER BY source_name
